name: com.kraneapp/krane
title: Krane
description: Facts about Krane, the iPhone business card scanner, and a business card reader for agents.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Krane's free plan and Krane Pro: what each includes, the US monthly and yearly prices, and billing terms.

tools.name: check_feature
tools.description: Whether Krane does something, e.g. "Salesforce sync", "offline", "badge scanning", "Japanese cards", "Android". Returns yes (free plan), pro (Krane Pro), partial or no, with a one-paragraph answer and a page.

feature.description: The feature or question, in a few words.

tools.name: compare
tools.description: Krane next to Blinq, CamCard, Covve, Haystack, HiHello or Popl: when to pick which, and a row-by-row table where each rival value has the URL of the rival's own page it was read from.

competitor.description: Blinq, CamCard, Covve, Haystack, HiHello or Popl.

tools.name: get_download_link
tools.description: The App Store link for Krane, the devices it runs on and the iOS version it needs.

tools.name: contact_request
tools.description: Emails a question to Krane's founder, who answers by email. Use only when your user asked to contact Krane and agreed to share the email address and message you send; set user_consent to true to confirm that. Send nothing your user didn't approve.

email.description: Your user's email address, for the reply.

user_consent.description: true only if your user agreed to send this.

tools.name: request_scan_access
tools.description: Issues an access token for scan_business_card, good for 3 free reads. Call it once, before the first scan. It needs the name of the assistant or app calling, and your user's name and email address; ask your user first and set user_consent to true only if they agreed to share them with Krane. One access per email address: asking again returns the same token and what is left on it.

agent.description: The assistant or app making this call, e.g. "ChatGPT" or your product's name.

purpose.description: Optional: what the cards are for, in a few words.

user_consent.description: true only if your user agreed to share their name and email with Krane.

tools.name: scan_business_card
tools.description: Reads one photo of a paper business card and returns the contact: name, company, job title, phones, emails, websites, address and social handles, in the script printed on the card. Needs an access_token from request_scan_access (3 reads per token; a photo with no card on it still counts). Send the photo as image_url (a public https link) or image_base64, not both. The photo is read and not kept.

image_url.description: A public https:// link to the photo (JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF).

image_base64.description: The photo as base64 (JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF), about 1600 pixels on its long side.
